Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 6

“The valiant Yudhamanyu, the mighty Uttamaujas, the son of Subhadra, and the sons of Draupadi — all of them great chariot-warriors.”

The roll call closes with Abhimanyu (Subhadra's son) and Draupadi's five sons — the younger generation of the Pandava side, whose presence raises the stakes of the coming war for the entire family line.
